title: Buzznerd Trucks Launches First Trailer Websites for Coast Hyundai Trailers and Intermountain Trailer
description: Buzznerd's first trailer-dealer websites — Intermountain Trailer and Coast Hyundai Trailers — launch with automatic Truck Paper inventory sync, language translation, and interactive product pages.

props.text: Two trailer-dealer sites with Truck Paper inventory sync, language translation, and interactive product pages.
Buzznerd Trucks is proud to announce the launch of our first trailer websites, Intermountain Trailer and Coast Hyundai Trailers. Both sites are automatically updated with inventory from Truck Paper!
With capabilities for language translation for their Spanish-speaking customers, Intermountaintrailer.com is a new breed of efficiency, ease-of-use, and style.
Clean and custom-styled but not overbearing, Coast Hyundai Trailers features interactive product pages that allow the customer to get the details they need.
